name: web-effects-pack
description: An effects & transitions pack for the web — film burns, filmstock grading, hand-drawn scribbles — built with CSS, HTML and WebGL.

scripts.build:lib: rm -rf dist/lib && for f in src/effects/*/index.ts; do LIB_SLUG=$(basename $(dirname $f)) vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts || exit 1; done
